items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: Yes, I knew him in New York. Played with Clarence Williams. Frank Keeling on.

ctx.x: Yes, I knew him in New York. Played with Clarence Williams. Frank Keeling on.
Huh? Yes, Frank Keeling. Yeah, that's a fine place.
You remember Clarence Williams, mister? I said, you remember Clarence Williams? I knew Clarence Williams in New York, yes. And that's Zeno on drums. I've never seen him.
